notes: On 20 March 2021, several dozen protesters gathered in Cathedral Square in central Vilnius to demonstrate against coronavirus restrictions, especially compulsory wearing of face masks. An MP from the opposition Freedom and Justice party was present at the event. The rally was reportedly part of an international movement, which organized protests against coronavirus restrictions on this day in over 50 countries.
evidence: demonstrate against coronavirus restrictions, especially compulsory wearing of face masks

notes: On 1 May 2025, people participated in a protest organized by the Socialist Party and the National Congress of Industrialists and Entrepreneurs, marching from the Circus to the Opera and Ballet Theatre in Chisinau - Buiucani. The demonstration was directed against the PAS leadership and the president, calling for social justice and dialogue with Russia. The protest was led by Socialist Party members of Parliament. There are indications that participants were brought to the event via organized transportation. The Soviet song 'Katyusha' was played during the event.
evidence: directed against the PAS leadership and the president, calling for social justice and dialogue with Russia

notes: On 11 April 2023, striking NHS junior doctors represented by BMA formed a picket line outside Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge over a pay dispute and working conditions. The event was part of a four-day national industrial action.
evidence: striking NHS junior doctors ... over a pay dispute and working conditions

notes: On 8 February 2025, around 2,000 teachers, called by the Board of Teaching Staff, protested in Santander (Cantabria) to reject the government's latest salary adjustment proposal, which they deemed insufficient. Protesters criticized the regional government's offer of a 90-euro increase in three installments, while also condemning proposed conditions tying salary increases to attendance, arguing it unfairly penalized teachers on medical leave.
evidence: teachers ... to reject the government's latest salary adjustment proposal, which they deemed insufficient

notes: On 12 May 2020, Albanian land workers, who are permanent residents in Imathia [coded to Veroia] participated in a strike-protest demanding an increase of their wages.
evidence: Albanian land workers ... participated in a strike-protest demanding an increase of their wages

notes: On 1 April 2023, 40 anarchist activists took to the streets of Cesena (Emilia-Romagna, Forli-Cesena) to demonstrate in solidarity with Alfredo Cospito, a well-known anarchist currently on hunger strike to demonstrate against the 41-bis prison regime, and 3 other anarchists currently charged with theft, among others, after a 'No Green Pass' demonstration held on 13 November 2021.
evidence: solidarity with Alfredo Cospito ... hunger strike ... against the 41-bis prison regime

notes: On 12 March 2025, students of the Higher School of Electrical Engineering and Computing Vocational Studies gathered in Vojvode Stepe Street in Belgrade - Vozdovac to observe 15 minutes of silence as part of the 'Serbia, Stop' campaign. The aim was to honor the victims and emphasize their demands for the accountability for the loss of 15 lives following the collapse of a concrete canopy at the Novi Sad railway station.
evidence: demands for the accountability for the loss of 15 lives following the collapse of a concrete canopy at the Novi Sad railway station

notes: On 29 May 2021, Belarusian activists gathered for a rally in Biala Podlaska, declaring their solidarity with the political opposition at home and demanding immediate release of journalist Protasevich, who was arrested in Minsk.
evidence: solidarity with the political opposition at home and demanding immediate release of journalist Protasevich

notes: On 24 January 2022, campaigners belonging to Stop HS2 and HS2 Rebellion (associated with Extinction Rebellion) demonstrated with banners and a prop elephant called Nelly at Euston station in London - Camden as part of a full day of action against the expansion of the HS2 infrastructure project.
evidence: action against the expansion of the HS2 infrastructure project

notes: On 26 August 2021, Alitalia airline company workers, including flight attendants, gathered outside the company's former headquarters in Rome - Europa (Roma, Lazio) to demand guarantees for their professional future following the reorganization of Alitalia as ITA.
evidence: to demand guarantees for their professional future following the reorganization of Alitalia as ITA

notes: On 23 November 2022, citizens, summoned by CSIF, held a protest in Malaga (Andalucia) to demand quality public services and denounce deficiencies in health, education, justice, and the Andalusian government.
evidence: demand quality public services and denounce deficiencies in health, education, justice, and the Andalusian government

notes: On 22 October 2020, people, most of them FdI affiliates and including their leader, took part in a flash mob outside of Montecitorio Palace in Rome - City Center to protest against the potential introduction of a second lockdown to face coronavirus infections by the government and denounce the consequences of the public handling of the coronavirus pandemic on certain professional categories.
evidence: protest against the potential introduction of a second lockdown ... consequences of the public handling of the coronavirus pandemic

notes: Around 23 July 2021 (as reported), over 500 people took the street in Palermo (Palermo, Sicilia) to pay tribute to an anti-mafia magistrate killed in the 1992 Via D'Amelio bombing and protest against mafia presence within the state.
evidence: protest against mafia presence within the state

notes: On 12 September 2022, around 600 people demonstrated in Kothen for peace in Ukraine and against 'state paternalism' concerning health and other matters.
evidence: demonstrated in Kothen for peace in Ukraine

notes: On 19 November 2021, citizens called by the ADICAE association protested in Zaragoza (Aragon) against the recent increases in power prices.
evidence: protested ... against the recent increases in power prices

notes: On 20 June 2020, about 700 people marched through Cobham village in Surrey for a Black Lives Matter protest, demonstrating against police brutality and systemic racism after the killing of an unarmed black man by a police officer in the United States.
evidence: a Black Lives Matter protest, demonstrating against police brutality and systemic racism

notes: On 24 November 2023, people gathered inside Gare du Nord in Paris (Ile-de-France) to express solidarity with the Palestinian people amid the 2023 Israel-Hamas War.
evidence: solidarity with the Palestinian people amid the 2023 Israel-Hamas War

notes: On 7 December 2020, about 20 activists affiliated to the movement Million Moments for Democracy gathered for a rally in Karlovy Vary, protesting against alleged harmful pressure against the media of public service from politicians. They demanded preservation of independence especially of the national TV station Czech Television.
evidence: protesting against alleged harmful pressure against the media of public service from politicians

notes: On 19 September 2022, people demonstrated in Greifswald against inflation.
evidence: people demonstrated in Greifswald against inflation

notes: On 20 April 2024, around 25 Last Generation activists gathered in Saarbrucken (Saarland), demanding increased government action on climate change, resulting in 6 participants being taken into custody by the police.
evidence: demanding increased government action on climate change

notes: On 20 October 2020, primary care physicians (general practitioners) called by the Malaga Medical Union gathered in Malaga to protest about excessive work overload during the coronavirus pandemic. Protesters demanded more human and material resources be allocated to the public health services.
evidence: protest about excessive work overload during the coronavirus pandemic; demanded more human and material resources ... public health services

notes: On 1 March 2019, in Rekovac, Serbia citizens held a protest against the regime of Aleksandar Vucic. This protest was a part of a series of protests happening throughout the country for several weeks.
evidence: citizens held a protest against the regime of Aleksandar Vucic

notes: On 14 September 2024, around 2,500 people participated in the Christopher Street Day (CSD) parade in Dortmund (Nordrhein-Westfalen), to protest for LGBTQ+ rights and visibility. Around 50 right-wing individuals staged a counter-protest nearby, while at the call of Antifa, around 150 left-wing protesters demonstrated against the right-wing protest. The police effectively kept the groups apart. Two right-wing protesters were detained for making homophobic remarks and performing a Hitler salute. In addition, there were minor incidents, including children attempting to throw eggs at CSD participants.
evidence: to protest for LGBTQ+ rights and visibility

notes: On 21 November 2024, farmers, including CR affiliates, gathered with a dozen tractors in Strasbourg (Grand Est), where they distributed 600 kilograms of apples in a demonstration. The event was part of a nationwide demonstration movement by French farmers opposing the EU-Mercosur trade deal and condemning delays in agricultural reforms promised by the previous government following the winter 2023-2024 farmers' demonstrations.
evidence: farmers ... opposing the EU-Mercosur trade deal and condemning delays in agricultural reforms

notes: On 12 December 2020, around 80 persons demonstrated in Clichy. They called for decent housing for undocumented families, housed by the city council in unsanitary hotels.
evidence: called for decent housing for undocumented families, housed by the city council in unsanitary hotels

notes: On 10 November 2020, 16 teachers protested in Auxerre to denounce the government's management of the coronavirus health crisis. They denounced a lack of means and space so that the classes could safely take place. They called for splitting up classes into small groups in middle schools. They also called for more financial, material, and human resources. They also denounced what they perceive as disdain from the government.
evidence: teachers ... denounced a lack of means and space so that the classes could safely take place ... splitting up classes

notes: On 13 February 2022, citizens called by 'We are not crime platform' protested in Vitoria-Gasteiz, demanding the repeal of the Law on Public Safety. They said that the law limits freedoms and criminalises protest activity. The CNT, CGT, Amnesty International, Ecologists in Action, Greenpeace and CEAR unions and organizations were involved in the demonstration.
evidence: demanding the repeal of the Law on Public Safety ... the law limits freedoms and criminalises protest activity

notes: On 15 October 2021, in the morning, Electrolux workers gathered, with the support of RSU union representatives, outside their company's gates in Susegana (Treviso, Veneto) to protest against the extension of coronavirus 'green pass' restrictions to public and private sector workers, set to come into force on that day. Vaccinated workers reportedly took part in the protest to express solidarity with their colleagues.
evidence: protest against the extension of coronavirus 'green pass' restrictions to public and private sector workers

notes: On 7 January 2022, several far-right affiliates gathered in Acca Larentia street in Rome - Tuscolano (Roma, Lazio) to commemorate the victims of the 1978 Acca Larentia killings and denounce the role of the far left in the killings. Demonstrators performed the Fascist salute and several of them did not wear a mask in compliance with coronavirus restrictions. CasaPound took part in the demonstration.
evidence: commemorate the victims of the 1978 Acca Larentia killings and denounce the role of the far left in the killings

notes: On 24 April 2021, people protested in Plevenon against the failure to carry out votes during the municipal councils due to the resignation of the municipal councilors. They called for the budget to be voted.
evidence: protested ... against the failure to carry out votes during the municipal councils ... called for the budget to be voted
